# Playbooks: Release the LPM product (maintainers) (`lpm-release-product`)

Load a section only when `lpm-release-product.md` tells you to.

## § flow-deploy-preflight

## Flow: preflight before a candidate deploy
Load when: SKILL.md P2 step 1

### Preconditions
1. mainPath, wtPath: SKILL.md §3. Run every step in wtPath unless the step names mainPath.
2. Nothing else edits wtPath until the deploy exits (the deploy uploads the working dir with `--source .`).

### Steps
1. `git -C ../agents-skills pull` (deploy parity reads its `main`). Fails → Stop table.
2. `git fetch origin && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD`; exit ≠ 0 → the branch is behind origin/main → Stop table.
3. `git status --porcelain` → only `?? .gcloudignore`, plus `?? node_modules` when `test -L node_modules`; any other line → STOP and report it.
4. `gcloud meta list-files-for-upload . | sort` in wtPath and in mainPath → diff; a line not in `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AD $(git -C <mainPath> rev-parse HEAD) HEAD` → STOP and report the diff. `node_modules/` or `.git/` listed → fix `.gcloudignore` (SKILL.md P1 step 2), repeat this step.
5. `test -n "$LPM_API_KEY"` (no echo, never print the key); fails → Stop table.
6. Verify: steps 1–5 passed; keep one pass line per step for the release report ("Upload check").

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| step 1 fails, or local `main` ≠ `origin/main` | "agents-skills main is out of sync with origin/main; deploy stopped." |
| step 2 fails | "The branch lacks origin/main; rebase it first. Deploy stopped." |
| step 5 fails | "Set LPM_API_KEY (reads the demo, LPM and XporY workspaces) in this shell; I will not create a key." |

### Verify
Step 6.

### Report fields
One line per step: pass, or the failing output.


## § flow-golden-eval

## Flow: golden-set evaluation of a candidate
Load when: SKILL.md P3

### Preconditions
1. candidateUrl, revision, projectId, issueId, mainPath, wtPath: SKILL.md §3 (new session: `release-inputs.md`). subsetIds: advisor-golden-set Facts; pilotWorkspaceId = `workspaceId` of the `xpory-` questions. `test -n "$LPM_API_KEY"` passed; never print the key.
2. Baseline per id, taken BEFORE step 4 so the new report is not its own baseline: `jq -r '.generatedAt as $t | .results[] | [.id, $t, .pass] | @tsv' <mainPath>/docs/evaluation/reports/advisor-*.json <wtPath>/docs/evaluation/reports/advisor-*.json | sort -k1,1 -k2,2r | awk '!seen[$1]++'` → one line per id: id, report time, `true`/`false`. An id with no line → "no baseline" for that id only.
3. Golden ledger (today, UTC): `for f in <mainPath>/../lpm*/docs/evaluation/reports/advisor-$(date -u +%F)T*.json; do jq -e '[.results[].id | select(startswith("xpory-"))] | length > 0' "$f" >/dev/null && echo "$f"; done`, plus `list_comments`(projectId, issueId) → a `content` starting "golden-full-run <today>". Any hit, or unsure → a full XporY run happened today.
4. Remaining XporY tokens today: no MCP tool returns today's use. Only the owner can state it in this conversation (or read it in the web AI-cost view). `get_workspace_ai_config`(workspaceId=pilotWorkspaceId) → `usageLimits.dailyTokenBudget` is the limit, not the use; `null` = no daily limit (not "unknown").

### Steps
1. Default ids = subsetIds (demo and LPM). At most one full XporY run per UTC day.
2. Full run only when precondition 3 found no run today AND the owner stated remaining tokens ≥ (number of `xpory-` questions × 18k) + 60k (advisor-golden-set rule 1). Else subsets only.
3. One new `xpory-` regression question → `--only <id>` when step 2's budget check passes for one question; else tomorrow.
4. `LPM_BASE_URL=<candidateUrl> npx tsx scripts/evaluate-advisor-golden-set.ts --only <ids>` → keep the `Report:` path (reportFile). Never `--with-answers`.
5. Per id: `true` in its baseline and FAIL now → re-run that id once (`--only <id>`); still FAIL → Stop table.
6. FAIL with `ai_usage_limit_reached` is no measurement → Stop table; never raise a budget.
7. Commit reportFile in wtPath with the `LPM-Activity:` trailer, so the next run has a baseline (the owner prefers not to commit → copy it to `<mainPath>/docs/evaluation/reports/` after the deploy).
8. After a full XporY run → `create_comment`(projectId, issueId, content="golden-full-run <YYYY-MM-DD UTC> <revision> <reportFile>", idempotencyKey="golden-full-<yyyymmdd>") [A] → commentId from "Comment created with ID: <id>".
9. Verify: reportFile schema is `advisor-golden-set-report/1`; no id went `true` → FAIL; after step 8, SKILL.md §7 comment check for commentId.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| step 5 regression | "Question <id> regressed (PASS → FAIL). Promotion stopped." |
| step 6 | "The golden run hit the AI budget (<workspace>); it is no measurement. Promotion stopped." |
| full run wanted, ledger hit or tokens not stated | subsets only; never change a budget |

### Verify
Step 9.

### Report fields
ids (subset or full); pass rate baseline → now; regressions (ids or none); "no baseline" ids; reportFile; ledger commentId.


## § flow-rollback-evidence

## Flow: rollback, evidence, report and pilot notice
Load when: decision rows 7 and 8 of SKILL.md

### Preconditions
1. workspaceId, projectId, issueId, revision, `<svc>`, `<live>`: SKILL.md §3. Rollback target: P4 step 1 output of this run, captured BEFORE promotion; new session → `release-inputs.md` (from `list_comments`(projectId, issueId)); none → STOP: SKILL.md §6 row "rollback target not found".
2. Guard (also when the user named the target): rollback target == current `<live>` output → STOP: "The rollback target <X> already serves 100 %. Which revision should take the traffic?"
3. activityId is the feed entry, NOT issueId: `list_workspace_activities`(workspaceId, projectId, limit=50) → newest `id` with `targetType == "issue"`, `targetId == issueId`.

### Steps
0. Re-run `<live>` and the precondition 2 guard right before step 1.
1. Rollback: `gcloud run services update-traffic <svc> --to-revisions=<rollback target>=100`.
2. Re-run the SKILL.md P4 step 6 smoke; keep both smoke outputs (failing smoke line = the `MCP smoke` line of P4 step 6; second smoke line = the `MCP smoke` line of this step).
3. `create_comment`(projectId, issueId, content="rolled back to <rollback target>\nsmoke before: <failing smoke line>\nsmoke after: <second smoke line>", idempotencyKey="rel-<revision>-rollback") [A].
4. Run steps 6–9 and 11 for the smoke and rollback outputs.
5. Verify: `<live>` prints exactly the rollback target; second smoke passed (else Stop table). STOP after that: no second promotion, no pilot notice (step 10).
6. Resolve activityId. None → `create_comment`(projectId, issueId, content="Release evidence follows.", idempotencyKey="rel-<revision>-anchor") [A]; resolve again.
7. Resolve existing attachments: part of step 8 (its first call); never skip it.
8. First `list_activity_attachments`(projectId, activityId); then for each kind (tests, golden, smoke, rollback) whose fileName is not listed: `upload_activity_attachment`(projectId, activityId, fileName="rel-<revision>-<kind>.txt", fileType="text/plain", contentBase64, description, idempotencyKey="rel-<revision>-<kind>") [A]. For these 4 kinds fileName always ends in .txt and fileType is always text/plain. contentBase64 = base64 of this text per kind:
   - tests = the 3 summary lines of SKILL.md P1 step 5;
   - golden = subset ids, pass rate prev -> now, regressions, reportFile path (never the report JSON itself);
   - smoke = each `MCP smoke` line;
   - rollback = the step 3 comment text (no rollback → skip this kind).
   - only UI screenshots (see `lpm-release-product.refs.md` § ui-e2e-emulator rule 3): kind `ui-<width>x<height>`, fileName="rel-<revision>-ui-<width>x<height>.png", fileType="image/png", contentBase64 = base64 of that PNG.
   No secrets, no answer text, no raw report or log file.
9. `create_comment`(projectId, issueId, content=<report of see `lpm-release-product.refs.md` § release-report-template>, idempotencyKey="rel-<revision>-report") [A].
10. P4 step 7 passed, no rollback → pilot notice of the same template → give it to the user; never message pilots yourself. Else no notice.
11. Verify: `list_activity_attachments`(projectId, activityId) lists every returned id; SKILL.md §7 comment check passes for each commentId ("Comment created with ID: <id>").

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| smoke fails after rollback too | "Production fails on <rollback target> too. Owner action needed." |
| a call fails | read its card in `lpm-release-product.tools.md`; still failing → STOP |

### Verify
Steps 5 and 11; SKILL.md §7.

### Report fields
Rollback target, both smoke lines, attachment ids, pilot notice or "not sent: <reason>".
